result.question: Quais municípios com mais de 500 internações aparecem simultaneamente no top-20 de volume e no top-20 de taxa de mortalidade nos estados MA e RS?
result.gold_sql: WITH top_volume AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20), top_mortalidade AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT tv.nome FROM top_volume tv WHERE tv.nome IN (SELECT nome FROM top_mortalidade) ORDER BY tv.nome;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT mu."nome", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu."nome" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ), taxa_mortalidade AS ( SELECT mu."nome", SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu."nome" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ), top_internacoes AS ( SELECT "nome", total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rn FROM total_internacoes ), top_taxa AS ( SELECT "nome", taxa, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY taxa DESC) AS rn FROM taxa_mortalidade ) SELECT ti."nome" FROM top_internacoes ti JOIN top_taxa tt ON ti."nome" = tt."nome" WHERE ti.rn <= 20 AND tt.rn <= 20;
